items.question: 최근 7일 일별 문의 접수 건수 추이는?
지난주 대비 이번 주 기기 유형별 세션 수를 비교해줘
최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 nov_mega_sale 캠페인 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7 THEN '최근 7일'
    ELSE '이전 7일'
  END AS period,
  SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
  AND summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY MIN(summary_date)

items.question: 최근 28일 주말(토·일)과 평일의 하루 평균 세션 수를 비교해줘
최근 28일 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 이메일(email) 매체 유입 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::int AS iso_weekday,
  SUM(sessions)::bigint AS email_sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND traffic_medium = 'email'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)
ORDER BY iso_weekday

items.question: 15일 전과 14일 전의 기기 유형별 결제 완료 건수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  (current_date - 15)::date AS summary_date,
  e.device_type,
  count(*) AS is_payment_count
FROM events e
WHERE e.event_name = 'is_payment'
  AND e.timestamp >= ((current_date - 15)::date)::timestamp
  AND e.timestamp < ((current_date - 14)::date)::timestamp
GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT
  (current_date - 14)::date AS summary_date,
  e.device_type,
  count(*) AS is_payment_count
FROM events e
WHERE e.event_name = 'is_payment'
  AND e.timestamp >= ((current_date - 14)::date)::timestamp
  AND e.timestamp < ((current_date - 13)::date)::timestamp
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

    SELECT
        summary_date,
        SUM(sessions) AS daily_sessions

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT 
        date_trunc('month', summary_date)::date AS month_start,
        SUM(page_views)                         AS total_page_views,
        COUNT(DISTINCT summary_date)            AS days
    FROM agg_page_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date
      AND summary_date <  (date_trunc('month', current_date) + interval '1 month')::date
    GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT
    CASE 
        WHEN month_start = date_trunc('month', current_date)::date THEN '이번 달'
        ELSE '지난달'
    END                                 AS month,
    (total_page_views::numeric / NULLIF(days, 0)) AS avg_daily_page_views
FROM monthly
WHERE month_start IN (
    date_trunc('month', current_date)::date,
    (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date
)
ORDER BY month_start;

       avg_daily_pageviews
FROM (
    SELECT 'last_month' AS period,
           AVG(daily_views) AS avg_daily_pageviews
    FROM (
        SELECT summary_date,
               SUM(page_views) AS daily_views
        FROM agg_page_daily
        WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '1 month'
          AND summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)
        GROUP BY summary_date
    ) lm
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'this_month' AS period,
           AVG(daily_views) AS avg_daily_pageviews
    FROM (
        SELECT summary_date,
               SUM(page_views) AS daily_views
        FROM agg_page_daily
        WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)
          AND summary_date <= current_date
        GROUP BY summary_date
    ) tm
) sub
ORDER BY period;
